newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Damaged Australian oil rig heads to Singapore.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Damaged Australian oil rig heads to Singapore.

text.p: A damaged offshore drilling rig disabled during installation off the South Australian coast is due to arrive in Singapore this week to be repaired, owner Maersk Contractors said in a statement on Tuesday.
The statement said the Singapore-based Far East Livingstone Ship Building had won the repair bid ahead of the Adelaide-based Australian Submarine Corp (ASC).
It did not give details on the cost of the work.
Maersk said while the ASC had submitted a cost-competitive tender, the Singaporean company would complete the specialist repairs in a shorter time-frame.

The rig was disabled during installation in November in the first stage of a A$15 million petroleum exploration program by Canyon (Australia) Pty Ltd, owned by private Texan based oil and gas explorer and producer Wagner and Brown Ltd.
Maersk said work was continuing on the recovery of the three legs of the rig, parts of which remain buried in the seabed.
The company intended to return the drilling rig to Australia once it was repaired, it said.
